name: MSCI Connector
description:
The MSCI Connector provides access to an expanding range of MSCI AI-enabled data and analytics capabilities. Based on entitlements users can investigate index performance characteristics such as country, sector and factor exposures, constituent weights and methodologies and explore private assets market trends, performance benchmarking and holdings and risk factors. Clients can also analyze portfolio risk analytics and factor exposures and explore and assess companies on key sustainability and climate (S&C) metrics including ESG Ratings, controversies, business involvement screening, and emissions.

The connector is designed for investment professionals who require transparent, methodology-aligned data to support portfolio construction, risk analysis, attribution, exposure analysis, sustainability and climate analysis and private assets research.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MSCI Connector to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MSCI Connector to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.msci.com/mcp/v1.0/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MSCI Connector MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MSCI Connector lists 26 MCP tools, including execute_index_gql_schema, get_index_gql_schema_fragments, get_pci_measure_detail, get_pci_user_profiles, get_pa_help, get_tpm_context, get_tpm_logins, get_tpm_transparency_analysis, get_rai_catalog, get_rai_metadata, get_rai_results, and get_rai_reference_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MSCI Connector?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MSCI Connector in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does MSCI Connector MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MSCI Connector requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MSCI Connector is developed by MSCI Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
